issue.title: [bug] Remote magpie 指向纯 IPv6 地址时，IPv4 回退把主机锁 30 分钟，报 dial tcp4: lookup …: no such host
issue.body:
NAS 上 Docker 跑 magpie，外面套了 lucky 做 TLS 反代，Windows 桌面版把它加成 **Remote magpie** 来用。NAS 没有公网 IPv4，所以网关域名只有 AAAA 记录。IPv6 一直是通的，curl 随手就能拿到应答，但桌面版连不上，点「测试模型」和实际对话都是这句：

```
group/glm-5.3-flash 通过 OpenAI 协议没有响应：dial tcp4: lookup <host>: no such host
```

从我的中继出去也是同一句：`NAS: Post "https://<host>:<port>/v1/chat/completions": dial tcp4: lookup <host>: no such host`

烦人的是它时好时坏。刚把供应商填进去的时候，「获取模型列表」是成功的 —— 列表上「27分钟前」那一份就是它拉的。用着用着开始全挂，挂一段时间，又好了。

## 先排除了 DNS

第一反应是自己的解析出了问题，于是在同一台 Windows 上做了三件事：

```
PS> curl.exe -sS -o NUL -w "auto: %{http_code}`n" https://<host>:<port>/v1/models
auto: 401

PS> curl.exe -4 -sS --max-time 8 https://<host>:<port>/v1/models
curl: (6) Could not resolve host: <host>

PS> Resolve-DnsName <host> | ft Name,Type,IPAddress

Name    Type IPAddress
----    ---- ---------
<host>  AAAA <redacted-ipv6>
```

双栈 curl 是通的（401 是网关要密钥，正常应答），只有强制 IPv4 才失败，因为这个名字根本没有 A 记录。又去 NAS 上翻了容器日志，请求都在正常到达、因为密钥不对被拒。服务端和链路都没有问题。

`dial tcp4` 是唯一的线索：有人在给一个没有 IPv4 的名字拨 IPv4。

## 翻源码找到了

`internal/netproxy/v4fallback.go`，当初为了修 TUN 那个场景加的（文件头注释：Clash/xray 的 TUN 会接下 IPv6 连接但带不出去）。`Dispatch` 给每个 transport 的 dialer 都套了这一层（`netproxy.go:158`，`http.DefaultClient` 在 `netproxy.go:30`）。某个 host:port 的 IPv6 连接一个字节都没回来就断了的话，它会被记下来，之后三十分钟改拨 IPv4（`v6Broken`，`v4fallback.go:26`）。标记还在的时候，network 被换掉：

```go
if network == "tcp" && !v4Since(addr).IsZero() {
    network = "tcp4"
}
```

这个回退的前提是主机有 IPv4 可以退。models.dev 和各家厂商都有，所以一直没暴露。只有 AAAA 记录的名字没有，`tcp4` 解析不出来，就成了 `dial tcp4: lookup …: no such host`，看着像 DNS 崩了，其实名字好好的。而且标记比它成立的理由活得久：回退根本不可能成立的时候，没有任何东西把标记撤掉。

间歇性也说得通了。标记在内存里（`v4fallback.go:28`），重启应用就清空：能用 → 某个 IPv6 连接提前断掉 → 三十分钟必挂 → 标记过期 → 又能用。我猜我这边是反代回收空闲 keep-alive 连接触发的，但没抓包，这只是猜测。

## 写了两个测试确认

在 `main` 上跑，两个红的：

```
=== RUN   TestUnresolvableIPv4DialClearsTheMark
    v4fallback_ipv6only_test.go:73: aaaa-only.example:443 is still marked IPv4-only after its IPv4
    dial failed with "dial tcp4: lookup aaaa-only.example: no such host"; the mark outlives the reason it was made
--- FAIL: TestUnresolvableIPv4DialClearsTheMark (0.00s)
=== RUN   TestHostWithNoIPv4IsDialedOverIPv6Again
    v4fallback_ipv6only_test.go:99: dial: dial tcp4: lookup aaaa-only.example: no such host (dialed [tcp4])
--- FAIL: TestHostWithNoIPv4IsDialedOverIPv6Again (0.00s)
=== RUN   TestMarkedHostWithIPv4KeepsUsingIt
--- PASS: TestMarkedHostWithIPv4KeepsUsingIt (0.00s)
```

第二条失败信息就是我应用里看到的那句，主机名换成了 `aaaa-only.example`。

## 我改了一版

思路是让回退承认「没得退」：先拨 `tcp4`，如果 IPv4 对这个名字压根没有地址，就撤掉标记，按原来的 `tcp` 拨。`noAddress` 读 `DNSError.IsNotFound`；Windows 上 Go 把 `WSAHOST_NOT_FOUND` / `DNS_INFO_NO_RECORDS` 映射成 `errNoSuchHost`，和 #265 撞到的是同一套映射。

```go
if network == "tcp" && !v4Since(addr).IsZero() {
    c, err := dial(ctx, "tcp4", addr)
    if !noAddress(err) {
        return v6Watch(c, err, addr)
    }
    unmarkV4(addr)
}
c, err := dial(ctx, network, addr)
return v6Watch(c, err, addr)
```

改完：

```
--- PASS: TestUnresolvableIPv4DialClearsTheMark (0.00s)
--- PASS: TestHostWithNoIPv4IsDialedOverIPv6Again (0.00s)
--- PASS: TestMarkedHostWithIPv4KeepsUsingIt (0.00s)
ok  	github.com/yetone/magpie/internal/netproxy	0.052s

整包：  ok  	github.com/yetone/magpie/internal/netproxy	3.437s
go vet -tags nogui ./internal/netproxy/   无输出
gofmt -l internal/netproxy/               无输出
```

`TestIPv4Fallback`（钉住双栈主机走 `tcp,tcp4,tcp4`，也就是这个回退当初要解决的那个场景）仍然通过，TUN 那条路没动。补丁和测试我可以提 PR。

有件事值得说：我一开始想的是把 `io.EOF` 加进 `v6Conn.seen` 的豁免名单，那是错的。文件头写着 TUN 那个场景就是「一个裸 EOF」，豁免它等于把这个功能废掉。问题不在 EOF 被算作失败，而在标记对一个没有 IPv4 的主机做了什么。

## 顺带一个小问题

`v4Retry` 返回的是重试的结果，重试自己失败时原始错误就丢了：

```go
// v4fallback.go:152
return t.RoundTrip(again)
```

所以我看到的是听起来像 DNS 的那句，而不是真正弄断 IPv6 连接的那个错误。两个都失败时把第一个报出来，能省下不少排查时间。这条不在上面的改动里，需要的话我一起加。

## 环境

- magpie v0.1.1436（Windows 11 桌面版）。顺手核过：这个 tag 的 `internal/netproxy/v4fallback.go` 和 `main` 的 SHA256 一致（`F1649A0B3156CF337C03FA4E0506646B0BAC87B05B1ABDAF3CB9A5BD2ECBB977`），所以不是版本旧的问题。
- 远端：fnOS（Debian）上 Docker 里的 `ghcr.io/yetone/magpie:latest`，前面是 TLS 反代，地址 `https://<host>:<port>`
- 该域名只有 AAAA 记录；NAS 完全没有公网 IPv4

## 没确认的地方

curl 输出和应用报错都来自这台机器，是应用正在失败的时候抓的；两个测试跑过。至于具体是什么事件挂上了标记，我没有确认，空闲连接被回收只是个猜测。

comments.body:
按你的诊断和修法实现并推到了 fork 分支 `fix/issue-batch-1025a`（[91fc2733](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/91fc2733)，skygunner/magpie），全部致谢归你：

- 标记主机的 tcp4 拨号若错误是解析器回答"该名字没有这个类型的地址"（`DNSError.IsNotFound`，Windows 上就是 WSAHOST_NOT_FOUND / DNS_INFO_NO_RECORDS 的映射），即撤销标记、按原样继续 IPv6 拨号——你的 `noAddress` 方案原样移植。
- 顺带项也加上了：`v4Retry\] 的重试自己失败时，报第一次的 IPv6 错误而不是重试自己的答案。

红→绿按你的两个测试名复刻：`TestUnresolvableIPv4DialClearsTheMark`（修复前"the mark outlives the reason it was made"）、`TestHostWithNoIPv4IsDialedOverIPv6Again`（修复前正是你应用里那句 `dial tcp4: lookup …: no such host (dialed [tcp4])`）；对照组 `TestMarkedHostWithIPv4KeepsUsingIt\] 与原 `TestIPv4Fallback` 的 tcp,tcp4,tcp4（TUN 场景）不变。`go test ./internal/netproxy` 47 全绿，gofmt/vet 干净。你在正文里说的"EOF 豁免是错的"那条判断我照抄进了理解——没有动 `v6Conn.seen`。

你提到可以自己提 PR：如果你的分支/补丁已经写好，贴出来即可覆盖这一版；这版只是把你验证过的方案先落地到 fork。

Verified skygunner's fix for #3519 (91fc2733, branch `fix/issue-batch-1025a`), checked out and re-tested independently. @Tinkler-i's diagnosis and `noAddress` design are ported exactly as suggested: a marked host:port's tcp4 dial whose error is the resolver's "no address of this kind" answer (`DNSError.IsNotFound`, matched through `errors.As`, so the real dial's `dial tcp4: lookup …` OpError wrapping counts too) clears the mark and the dial goes on over `tcp` as it was; and the side note is in as well — when the v4 retry itself fails, `v4Retry` now returns the first RoundTrip's `res, err`, the IPv6 failure that started it. One equivalence I checked rather than assumed: the tcp4 branch returns before the `v6Conn` wrap, but that wrap only ever applies to non-IPv4 remote addresses (`To4() == nil`), so a successful tcp4 dial took the same unwrapped path before this change — no drift for the TUN case.

Ablation holds: with only `v4fallback.go` reverted to the parent (fe330ea1) and the new test file kept, both tests fail with exactly the reported sentence:

```
    v4fallback_ipv6only_test.go:48: dial: lookup aaaa-only.example.com: no such host
--- FAIL: TestUnresolvableIPv4DialClearsTheMark (0.00s)
    v4fallback_ipv6only_test.go:81: dial: Get "https://aaaa-only.example.com/": lookup aaaa-only.example.com: no such host (dialed [tcp4])
--- FAIL: TestHostWithNoIPv4IsDialedOverIPv6Again (0.00s)
```

(the bare `lookup` shape, without the `dial tcp4:` prefix, is the test's mock dialer returning the `DNSError` directly — `noAddress` matches both shapes). At 91fc2733 both pass, the original `TestIPv4Fallback` — the `tcp,tcp4,tcp4` sequence the fallback was made for — stays green, and the package is clean on go1.25.5 darwin/arm64: `go test -count=1 ./internal/netproxy` ok with and without `-tags nogui`, `-race` ok, `gofmt` and `go vet` clean, `go build -tags nogui ./...` ok. One environment note: the control `TestMarkedHostWithIPv4KeepsUsingIt` skips on my machine (nothing listens on 127.0.0.1:80 to dial), so its green rests on the reporter's run of his own harness and skygunner's delivery run, not mine.

Boundary review, since a mark-clearing path invites the question of clearing a real failure: `IsNotFound` can only come from the resolver's own authoritative answer — connection refused, timeouts and resets are not `DNSError` and never clear the mark, so a dual-stack host whose IPv4 is merely down keeps the pre-change behavior. If a resolver ever answered not-found wrongly for a name that does have IPv4, the mark would clear and the plain `tcp` dial's own fallback would take over; if IPv6 then fails again on an established connection, `v6Conn.seen` re-marks — the worst state is no worse than unmarked. Sibling surface: the mark's only write points are `v6Conn.seen` and the new `unmarkV4`; the 30-minute expiry in `v4Since` is untouched; every symbol here is package-private to netproxy, whose only mounts (`v4Fallback` at netproxy.go:159, `v4Retry` at :181/:183) are unchanged — nothing else reads or writes the mark.

Branch notes for whoever picks this up: the branch has since moved ahead of 91fc2733 (four more commits for other issues, none touching netproxy, so this commit is still what the tip carries), and `v4fallback.go` is byte-identical between skygunner's base and current `main`, so the patch lands clean on `main` — only `netproxy.go`'s `Install` has gained the probelog wrapper since, which doesn't touch this path.

**Attribution**: written with GLM-5.3-Flash (ZCode); I've independently verified skygunner's patch.
